tasks.name: Fleet Coordinated Takeoff and Formation (4 Drones) 1
tasks.content: Four-drone coordination exercise: Drone 7, Drone 10, Drone 8, and Drone 4 take off together to 21 meters altitude, then hold formation at positions (489, 402, 21), (528, 452, 21), (649, 643, 21), and (427, 660, 21) respectively for synchronized operation. Then all four drones move north for 66m, and next move east for 115m. Each drone must complete the specified directional movements (north 66m, then east 115m) regardless of starting position - if obstacles block the path, drones should adjust position as needed to complete the full directed distance in each heading.
content_aliases: Coordinate Drone 7, Drone 10, Drone 8, and Drone 4: ascend together to 21 meters, establish square formation at positions (489, 402, 21), (528, 452, 21), (649, 643, 21), and (427, 660, 21) respectively, then execute coordinated movement north 66m followed by east 115m. All drones must complete the full directional distance (north 66m, east 115m) from their respective positions, adjusting as needed to avoid obstacles.

Four-drone formation drill: launch Drone 7, Drone 10, Drone 8, and Drone 4 to altitude 21m, hold stations at (489, 402, 21), (528, 452, 21), (649, 643, 21), and (427, 660, 21) respectively, then shift north by 66 meters and east by 115 meters in synchronized operation. Each drone travels the specified distance in each direction regardless of obstacles encountered.

Execute synchronized operation with Drone 7, Drone 10, Drone 8, Drone 4: take off reaching 21 meters height, maintain formation at coordinates (489, 402, 21), (528, 452, 21), (649, 643, 21), and (427, 660, 21) respectively, then proceed north for 66m and subsequently east for 115m together, with each drone completing the full directed movements by repositioning around obstacles if necessary.
